entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3855246074629979264: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.8703 +/- 0.0165 mas (same row, RUWE 0.84): 77.70 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 57.019, -68.871 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.703 +/- 0.024 solar radii from Rodriguez et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..245R/abstract). Mass 0.686 +/- 0.033 solar masses from Rodriguez et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156..245R/abstract). Temperature 4285 +/- 49 K from Rodriguez et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-266 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,285 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffd9b2. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,285 K and log g 4.58 (u1 0.757, u2 0.034): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
